scope: Canonical benchmark support metadata for yolozu benchmark and tools/benchmark_model.py.

legend.description: Benchmark runs the backend/export/eval path and writes real predictions/eval artifacts when the required model artifact and runtime are present; otherwise the report is skipped.
Benchmark consumes a backend-specific artifact and writes real eval/parity artifacts without claiming YOLOZU ran backend inference.
Benchmark writes an explicit placeholder artifact for dry-run planning only.
Benchmark records a missing runtime, missing model artifact, platform, or GPU requirement.
Task or format is visible in the interface contract but real benchmark wiring is not shipped; benchmark runs report skipped.

matrix.task_scope: classification, obb, segmentation, keypoints, depth, pose6d
matrix.behavior: auto resolves to artifact_eval; reject non-default backend execution flags before writing benchmark artifacts.
artifact_eval consumes prepared artifacts; reject backend precision, batching, and NMS options before writing benchmark artifacts.

matrix.task_scope: any task with an otherwise valid non-artifact_eval source
matrix.behavior: Accepted values are forwarded by torch detect execution or recorded in the benchmark report for planning-only execution.

matrix.task_scope: any task with an otherwise valid non-artifact_eval source
matrix.behavior: Current format paths do not consume these backend execution flags, so non-default values fail early.

formats.runtime_requirements: Python runtime plus task-specific torch/Ultralytics dependencies for detect; artifact-backed tasks consume supplied files.
formats.license_runtime_notes: No runtime is bundled by benchmark mode; users provide model artifacts and optional framework dependencies.

formats.runtime_requirements: ONNX Runtime and an .onnx artifact for detect; artifact-backed tasks consume supplied files.
formats.license_runtime_notes: ONNX Runtime is optional and environment-provided.

formats.runtime_requirements: Linux, GPU, TensorRT/CUDA bindings, and an .engine or .plan artifact for detect; artifact-backed tasks consume supplied files.
formats.license_runtime_notes: TensorRT/CUDA are optional external runtimes; benchmark reports skipped when unavailable.

formats.runtime_requirements: Local PyTorch and a TorchScript artifact for detect; artifact-backed tasks consume supplied files.
formats.license_runtime_notes: PyTorch is optional for this lane and supplied by the runtime environment.

formats.runtime_requirements: OpenVINO runtime and an OpenVINO IR .xml artifact for detect; artifact-backed tasks consume supplied files.
formats.license_runtime_notes: OpenVINO is optional and environment-provided; benchmark reports skipped when unavailable.

formats.runtime_requirements: Standalone exporter utilities may exist, but benchmark orchestration is not wired.
formats.license_runtime_notes: Visible for planning; benchmark reports benchmark_format_not_wired.

formats.runtime_requirements: Standalone OpenCV-DNN exporters may exist, but benchmark orchestration is not wired.
formats.license_runtime_notes: Visible for planning; benchmark reports benchmark_format_not_wired.
